Subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity pricing & token econ (Clover)

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can size a dedicated capacity recommendation that matches your cost target and throughput needs.

Key takeaways (from today's call)
- Workload: user-facing personalization + summarization for care teams. Mix of short prompts (~40 tokens) and longer summaries (~600 tokens) for longer contexts.
- Expected steady-state: ~50M tokens/month with spikes up to ~75M in busy weeks.
- Latency SLO: 95th < 200ms token latency for short prompts; summary jobs can tolerate higher tail.
- Primary constraint: predictable unit economics; your target was ~ $650 / 1M tokens (ballpark).
- Preferred hardware: you mentioned leaning toward A100s but open to guidance if H100 materially improves cost/throughput.

Questions we need answered to firm a quote
1) Average input+output tokens per request (ballpark) — helps with concurrency sizing.
2) Percent of requests that are live (interactive) vs. batch (asynchronous summaries).
3) Any data residency or private deployment constraints (VPC / on-prem).

Next steps
- I'll send a preliminary SKU matrix (attached) showing 2x sizing paths: conservative reserved pool (for predictability) and aggressive burst+shared fallback (for unit cost).
- If the token target and avg tokens per request line up, we can propose a 6–12 month reserved pricing with unit $/1M and committed throughput.
- Let's schedule a 30-min sizing call with your infra lead and our infra architect — available Wed/Fri next week.

Attachments: [Attachment: prelim-sku-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]

Thanks — Dylan

Thanks, Dylan — good summary. Quick answers below; happy to go into more detail on the sizing call.

- Average tokens/request: interactive personalization ~ 120 tokens (avg), summaries ~ 900 tokens when triggered. Overall weighted avg ~ 220 tokens.
- Traffic mix: 70% interactive, 30% async summaries.
- Monthly volume: we'll target 50M tokens/month steady; planning for spikes up to 75M in months where marketing campaigns or new feature rollouts hit.
- Concurrency/throughput: for interactive flows we need ~300 concurrent streams during peak; p95 request arrival is ~350 req/s at peak.
- Budget/target: Our procurement guideline is to stay <= $700 / 1M tokens; preferred target $650 if possible.
- Hardware: Our infra team prefers A100s due to compatibility with existing infra and cost predictability; open to H100 for heavy-context models if you can show unit-econ improvement.
- Compliance: standard BAA + SOC2 is fine; we'd prefer a VPC deployment for production traffic.

Looping in procurement for scheduling the pricing/contract discussion.

Best,
Alice

Thanks for the answers, Alice — helpful. A couple follow-ups from our side before we lock size and pricing:

1) Sequence length profile: can you confirm 95th percentile tokens for summary jobs (you said ~900 avg; is 95th closer to 1,500–2,000?)
2) Tokenization: are you already tokenizing with the standard encoder (that ~220 tokens avg is using the same tokenizer we size with)?
3) SLA expectations for reserved pool (downtime allowances / planned maintenance windows).

Preliminary sizing notes (based on your numbers)
- Interactive workload dominates: 70% interactive @ 120 tokens/request, p95 arrival 350 rps -> concurrency and KV cache needs point toward at least a 4x A100 reserved lane to hit latency SLO and provide headroom.
- Summary/backfill: batching will reduce cost for the 30% async; a 2x A100 shared pool for batch jobs looks reasonable.
- If you insist on stronger tail (p99) for interactive we should evaluate 6x A100 or a mixed pool with 2x H100 for peak-heavy windows.

Unit economics (ballpark)
- 4x A100 reserved lane + 2x shared A100 batch lane -> estimated delivered cost range: $580–$720 / 1M tokens depending on batching efficiency and prefix cache hit rates.
- Swap in H100 for hot-path: can reduce cost by ~8–12% for long-context workloads but adds hardware premium on reserved pricing.

Proposed next actions
- Confirm the 95th percentile summary token length and tokenizer (Alice).
- Schedule 30-min infra sizing call (Dylan to propose times).
- I'll prepare two formal options in a single quote: (A) A100-focused reserved pool priced to hit ~$650/1M, (B) mixed H100/A100 pool with improved long-context econ and a slightly higher reserved fee but lower unit token cost for summaries.
